prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: herbs chopped in a fast blur and smashed into softened butter, the green-flecked block rolled tight in paper. The camera whips to a thick alcatra steak hitting a scorching cast-iron pan — a roar, smoke rising, a hard crust building as it is pressed once. Money shot: the rested steak sliced into thick rosy slabs, then a disc of the herb butter laid on top — melting in real time, green-gold rivulets running down between the slices in extreme macro, backlit steam. Final beat: a slice lifted, butter dripping. Warm dramatic light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the sear roar, then the knife through crust. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
